      Map key
      
    
      
      
      
      
      
      
    
      
    
      
      
      
        
      Map symbols
      
        
      Project
      Open the outline to explore a project. Its number counts the missions inside.
      

      Psyche
      Open the crown to chat. The inner band tracks working agents. The outer band tracks missions waiting for you.
      

      Mission
      Select a seal to see its team. The cog button shows the task count and opens the list.
      

      Decision
      Open the numbered gate to review requests waiting for you.
      
      
      
      
      
        
      Familiars and agents
      
        
      Familiar color
      The inner arc shows target progress. The outer rim is solid while working, dotted when idle, dashed coral when blocked, and paired pale marks when a request needs you. Select its tinted group to center its agents. Area shows each task’s share of the agents. When its name will not fit, × and a number show its agent count.
      Agent and assignment
      Each dot is an agent. A square center marks a task assignment. Working agents are filled. Idle agents are hollow.
      Shared task
      A second hub color identifies a co-leading familiar. A dashed spot reserves a waiting agent’s place.
      
      
      
      
      
        
      Mission seals
      
        
      Council slices
      Each slice shows a familiar’s share of the agents. Its bright outer arc shows progress on that familiar’s targets.
      

      Mission state
      The name sits beside the seal. Its outline shows the mission state.
      

      Resource limit
      A coral arc marks a limit at or above 85% of time, tokens or budget.
      
      
      
      
      
        
      Connections and messages
      
        
      Project connection
      Psyche coordinates this Project. Filter by familiar to highlight its missions.
      Dormant connection
      No agents are assigned to this Project.
      Message in transit
      Lavender goes out from Psyche. Familiar colors come back. White marks a request for you.
